nav.title: Sahukar Shield
nav.tagline: Loan lene se pehle check karo. Asli byaj jaano. Dhamki mile to jawab do.

privacy_banner: Aapka data store nahi hota. Har jaankari sirf aapke screen par compute hoti hai aur process ke baad discard ho jaati hai.
disclaimer: Sahukar Shield ek consumer education aur awareness platform hai. Ye legal ya financial advice nahi hai. Kisi bhi legal action ke liye cyber police ya licensed advocate se salah lein.
emergency_strip: Turant Madad: Cyber Crime Helpline 1930 | National Portal: cybercrime.gov.in | RBI Sachet: sachet.rbi.org.in

home.hero_title: Loan lene se pehle check karo. Asli byaj jaano. Dhamki mile to jawab do.
home.hero_subtitle: Illegal 7-day loan apps se bachein. RBI register verify karein, 2000%+ APR ka asli sach samjhein, aur extortion messages ka kanooni jawab dein.
home.how_it_works_title: Sahukar Shield Kaise Kaam Karta Hai
home.step1_desc: RBI registered lender directory aur permissions check karke jaan lo ki app genuine hai ya illegal predatory trap.
home.step2_title: 2. Loan Lete Samay: Asli Byaj X-Ray
home.step2_desc: Screenshot upload karo. Code se calculated exact simple APR aur hidden deductions dekho. Sach samjho.
home.step3_title: 3. Dhamki Milne Par: Legal Action & PDF
home.step3_desc: Recovery messages classify karo. BNS & IT Act ke tehat cyber crime ready formal complaint PDF download karo.
home.sample_story: Ramesh ki kahani: Instagram pe ad dekha '5 minute me ₹5,000 loan'. ₹1,500 advance kaat ke mile sirf ₹3,500. 7 din baad ₹5,000 mange aur gallery photos leak karne ki dhamki di. Sahukar Shield ne 3 minute me case solve kiya.

verify.title: Loan App Verification & Risk Check
verify.subtitle: Play Store URL ya app ka naam likhein. RBI directory match aur permissions check karein.
verify.input_placeholder: Jaise: QuickRupee Instant, ya Play Store link...
verify.perms_heading: App kaunse permissions maang raha hai?

cost.title: True Cost X-Ray (Asli APR Calculator)
cost.subtitle: Loan offer ka screenshot upload karo ya text paste karo. Code aapka exact annualised interest rate calculate karega.

threat.title: Threat Shield (Dhamki Classifier)
threat.subtitle: Recovery agents ke WhatsApp/SMS messages paste karein ya screenshot upload karein.
threat.input_placeholder: Recovery agent ke messages paste karein (alag alag lines me)...

complaint.title: Cybercrime Complaint Builder
complaint.subtitle: Cyber crime portal (cybercrime.gov.in) aur 1930 helpline ke liye formal factual complaint draft aur PDF tayyar karein.
complaint.script_title: 1930 Call Script (30 Seconds me kya bolein)

family.title: Family Alert: Rishtedaaron Ke Liye Guide
family.subtitle: Agar aapko kisi aur ke loan ke naam par recovery agent se dhamki aayi hai, to pareshan na hon.
family.input_placeholder: Aapko jo dhamki bhara message aaya hai yahan paste karein...
family.whatsapp_card_desc: Ye message apne family WhatsApp group ya contacts me share karein taaki koi unhe blackmail na kar sake.

dashboard.title: Predatory Loan Scam Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Synthetic benchmark analytics: common predatory patterns, top reported fake apps, aur average APR.

about.title: Sahukar Shield Ke Baare Me
about.mission_desc: Bharat me lakho aam nagrik digital lending scams aur aggressive recovery harassment ka shikar hote hain. Sahukar Shield unhe tech aur kanooni samajh se surakshit karta hai.
